## What changed

Describe the behavior change and the operational problem it addresses.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant tests were added or updated.
- [ ] `python scripts/run_public_tests.py` passes.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when user-visible behavior changed.

## Data and security review

- [ ] The change contains no real military, government, customer, or company vulnerability data.
- [ ] The change contains no credentials, tokens, private keys, personal information, or local user paths.
- [ ] Any security claim is supported by a reproducible test or clearly marked as unverified.

## Scope

- [ ] The change preserves VulnFlow's stated single-host portfolio-project boundary, or the new boundary is explicitly documented.
